product.name: Monoprice 6-in-1 USB-C Multiport 4K@60Hz HDMI Adapter
product.description: Monoprice™6‑in‑1 USB‑C® Multiport 4K HDMI® AdapterMultifunction USB‑C adapter with 4K@60Hz HDMI, card readers, and 100W Power Delivery passthroughThe Monoprice™ 6‑in‑1 USB‑C® Multiport 4K HDMI® Adapter is an all‑in‑one video and data solution for USB‑C equipped laptops and computers with support for the DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode. You can extend your desktop with a second HDMI monitor with support for resolutions up to 4K@60Hz. It features both SD™ and microSD™ 3.0 card slots with support for the UHS‑I Speed Class and 104MBps read speeds. Each card slot is compatible with the MMC, SD, SDHC™, and SDXC™ formats with capacities up to 2TB and is individually addressed, so they can be used at the same time.Two USB 3.0 Type‑A ports and one Type‑C® port provide data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps, so you can connect a variety of USB peripherals and devices. The USB‑C port supports up to 100W of Power Delivery (PD) and one of the Type‑A ports supports 5 VDC, 1.5A (7.5W) of charging power, so you can keep all your devices fully charged and ready for use. This adapter is compatible with USB‑C equipped Windows® and macOS® systems that support DisplayPort Alt Mode, as well as systems with a Thunderbolt™ 3 connection.Supports HDMI® resolutions up to 4K@60Hz on DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode hosts or 4K@30Hz with DP 1.2 Alt ModeOne USB 3.0 Type‑C® and two Type‑A ports with data transfer rates up 5GbpsUp to 100W of USB Type‑C Power Delivery passthroughOne USB Type‑A port supports 5 VDC, 1.5A (7.5W) charging powerSD™ and microSD™ 3.0 card slots with support for the UHS‑I (104Mbps) Speed ClassCompatible with Windows® and macOS® operating systemsCompatible with Thunderbolt™ 3 systemsTrue Plug and Play device requires no external drivers or configurationCompact and lightweight design SIX‑IN‑ONEThe Monoprice™ 6‑in‑1 USB‑C® Multiport 4K HDMI® Adapter allows you to get the most out of a single DisplayPort® Alt Mode compatible USB‑C port. Connect an HDMI display, read data from SD™ and microSD™ cards, and connect one USB Type‑C® and two USB Type‑A devices. HIGH‑RESOLUTION 4K DISPLAYWhen connected to a host that supports the DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode, you can connect an HDMI® display at resolutions up to 4K@60Hz. For older systems with support for DP1.2 Alt Mode, it supports resolutions up to 4K@30Hz. STORE AND TRANSFER DATABoth SD™ and microSD™ card slots are included, each of which is individually addressed, so they can be used at the same time. They support the UHS‑I Speed Class (104MBps) and the SD, MMC, SDHC™, and SDXC™ formats, which allow for capacities up to 2TB.One USB 3.0 Type‑C® and two Type‑A ports allow you to connect a variety of external peripherals, such as hard drives, flash drives, printers, and keyboard and mouse input devices. They support data transfer rates up to 5Gbps, which is more than 10x faster than the older USB 2.0 standard. FAST CHARGINGThe USB‑C® port supports up to 100W of USB Type‑C® Power Delivery (PD) passthrough, allowing you to rapidly charge a laptop or other USB‑C compatible device. One of the Type‑A ports can provide 5 VDC, 1.5A (7.5W) of charging power for rapid charging of mobile devices. PLUG AND PLAYThe Monoprice™ 6‑in‑1 USB‑C® Multiport 4K HDMI® Adapter is a true Plug and Play device. Just plug it into a DisplayPort® 1.4 Alt Mode compatible USB‑C® port on your computer and use it right away. No external drivers or complicated configurations are required. WIDE COMPATIBILITYThis adapter is compatible with computers running the Windows® or macOS® operating systems, as well as systems with a Thunderbolt™ 3 connection. COMPACT AND LIGHTWEIGHTThe adapter body measures just 4.6" x 1.3" x 0.5" and weighs only 2.0 ounces, making it easy to pack in your laptop bag, backpack, or purse.
